name: Text
summary: Text in one of a closed list of roles — a heading level, body text or code — never a loose size. The reference library's Typography model.

a11y.apg: No pattern: a span with a type role. For a paragraph, a heading or code use Paragraph, Heading or Code, which render the element a screen reader expects; Text is for a run of text inside something else.

props.name: type
props.description: The role. The list is closed on purpose, like the reference library's: pick "h2" or "body-sm", never a pixel size. Only the look changes — the element stays a span, so a visual h2 is not a heading for a screen reader (use Heading for that).

props.name: color
props.description: Two colours only, like the reference library: the text colour or the muted one. A closed list protects contrast — both pass AA on every Aurea surface.

props.name: weight
props.description: Overrides the weight of the role. Headings are semibold and body text is regular by default. "extrabold" (800, --weight-extrabold) is for a cover title; the default title weight is still semibold.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. start and end follow the writing direction, so the same value mirrors in RTL.

props.name: truncate
props.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis. Turns the element into a block so the cut has a width to measure against.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) — for numbers that line up in a column (price, year, spec sheet) or change on screen. Off by default: in running text the narrow "1" is right. Native: the same prop sets fontVariant ["tabular-nums"].
